fact: SARS says its Single Window electronic inspection workflow, sharing inspection cases with the Border Management Authority, was implemented in September 2023 but is still in restricted testing with selected importers, and the full National Single Window is 'still some time away'.
SARS says it has an automated inspection and case management workflow that the Single Window extends to other government agencies.

fact: SARS says a new customs management system, replacing some 26 legacy and paper-based systems, was fully operational from 18 August 2013 for all commercial cross-border trade.
